glosses: The state or condition of being bankable.
An impediment that prohibits the use, adoption, application, etc. of (something).
A cost that must be incurred by a new entrant into a market, but which does not apply to incumbents.
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see barrier, to, entry.
vi_hint: (tài chính) Rào cản gia nhập; rào cản nhập ngành.

glosses: A benchmark interest rate, from which other interest rates are calculated; a policy rate.
Especially, the interest rate at which the Bank of England lends money to commercial banks.

One hundredth of one percentage point.

A negotiable loan instrument payable to its holder (bearer) by the issuer according to preset conditions. The owner must safeguard bearer bonds to prevent loss; interest is usually paid by coupon redemptions.

A stock market where a majority of investors are selling ("bears"), causing overall stock prices to drop. Often operationally defined as a market value drop of 20% or more on some specific stock market index.
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see bear, market.
The leading sheep of a flock, having a bell hung round its neck.
Anything that indicates future trends.
A stock whose price performance is treated as an indicator of the likely direction of a broader market, sector, or industry.
vi_hint: Cừu đầu đoàn có đeo chuông.
Vật chỉ ra xu hướng mai mốt.
Cổ phần hay trái phiếu được cho rộng rãi là có thể chỉ ra tình trạng của thị trường.

glosses: The difference between the prices quoted (by a market maker or an order book) for an immediate sale ("offer") and an immediate purchase ("bid") for stocks, futures contracts, options, or currency pairs.
A price offered by a buyer or bidder when purchasing a good.
To lower the price of (something, such as a financial security or a contract) by bidding lower and lower prices.
To bid by offering low interest rates on a lien, such that the lowest bidder will win.
A formal instrument for the conveyance or transfer of goods and chattels.
A unit of the bitcoin (proper noun proper noun sense 1) cryptocurrency.
A high-value poker chip.
A stock or other investment that has a high price because of its perceived reliability.
Synonym of blue-chipper.
The value of an asset as reflected on an entity's accounting books, without accounting for appreciation or depreciation.
The price for which an item or service should be bought or sold, usually as related in a printed collection of prices for similar items or services.
vi_hint: Giá trị sổ sách, giá trị ghi sổ.

glosses: A cheque returned by the bank due to insufficient funds.
To fall below the value of one dollar per share.
A sum of money loaned or borrowed for a short period of time in order to cover expenses until new expected funds become available.
The amount by which spending exceeds revenue.
A stock market where a majority of investors are buying ("bulls"), causing overall stock prices to rise.
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see bull, market.
An event in which people run with bulls in the streets.
A contiguous period during which a stock market is a bull market.
